reason: The diff changes CVRP local search directly. It replaces temporary capacity vectors with expression templates and route references, and replaces a nested regret scan with smallest and second-smallest insertion costs. The first mechanism affects per-event work; the second can affect the selected insertion and subsequent search trajectory.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Avoiding temporary capacity vectors and repeated regret scans may reduce CVRP local-search cost, while the changed insertion ordering could change fixed-budget solution quality.
causal_chain: CVRP job addition consults total route amounts and candidate insertion costs; expression templates defer amount arithmetic and a two-minimum scan supplies regret costs, changing allocation count, per-job work, and potentially the chosen route.
structural_trigger: CVRP runs that enter job-addition local search with at least two candidate routes; multidimensional capacities increase amount-arithmetic work, and unassigned jobs activate regret selection.
activation_probe: On public CVRP cases, count try_job_additions calls, qualifying jobs and routes, capacity-expression evaluations, and route choices in both pinned source states; include cases with and without job additions.
instance_selection_rule: Before hidden scoring, freeze public and held-out CVRP instances stratified by vehicle count, capacity dimension, and whether job-addition local search activates; fix seeds, budgets, and thread count.
workload_exposure_plan: The pinned 2018 CLI has no internal time-limit option and writes one terminal route. Use the shared driver external wall-clock cutoff and evaluate independently verified final normalized gap at the task budgets. Record solver completion wall time and all no-solution timeouts; do not claim an intermediate incumbent trajectory or PDI. The open-opportunity admission gate is a complete independently checked base-only hidden baseline with measurable final gap; neither the historical PR result nor any coding-agent result is an admission condition.
mathematical_risk: Expression-template references or capacity arithmetic can mis-evaluate feasibility; changed regret ordering can alter route assignment, solution quality, or termination behavior.
independent_check_plan: Recompute original CVRP visit coverage, vehicle capacities, and objective for every returned route; compare public base and PR trajectories and record crashes or missing solutions.
hidden_generalization_plan: Use the frozen 38-instance CVRPLIB X ID panel and a shifted CVRP family at declared fixed budgets, one seed for the deterministic pinned solver, and report independently verified final gap and per-instance regressions by vehicle/customer scale. Retain no-solution timeouts and failures. The CLI emits only a terminal route, so completion wall time is descriptive and any target event is only observed when the returned solution meets it; no intermediate trajectory or PDI is claimed.
overlap_review: This 2018 CVRP capacity-expression and regret-scan patch is distinct from VROOM #142's TSP heuristic patch and the 2025 insertion-bound patch #1222; inspect intervening amount and insertion PRs before admitting another task in this lineage.
resource_risk: Template expansion can increase code size or compilation cost, and retaining route references can expose lifetime errors despite fewer allocations.
measurement_scope_note: The legacy binary exposes only the final route. Fixed-budget terminal gap is the scored anytime outcome for this task family; completion wall time is retained for paired diagnostics but does not establish time-to-first-incumbent.
